# Vue Rich Text Editor UI

The Syncfusion Vue Rich Text Editor UI package provides a Vue wrapper for the Rich Text Editor UI component.

## Installation

Install the component and its peer dependencies from npm:

```bash
npm install @syncfusion/ej2-vue-richtexteditorui --save
```

## Setup

Register `RichTextEditorUIPlugin` when creating the application:

```typescript
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { RichTextEditorUIPlugin } from '@syncfusion/ej2-vue-richtexteditorui';
import App from './App.vue';

createApp(App).use(RichTextEditorUIPlugin).mount('#app');
```

Add the component to a template:

```html
<ejs-richtexteditorui></ejs-richtexteditorui>
```
